title: 第13章 夜里会有危险第14章 夜里危机四伏
slug: 快穿之时空星河伴第九章误闯雾山
content_zh:
昔小苑狠狠的瞪了沐梓丞一眼，一脸无所谓的说道：“好的吧，抢不过你就算了，我吃早点去了，大人不记小人过，不跟你计较。”
沐梓丞一脸嫌弃的说道：“抢不过就是抢不过，还那么多的废话，想去吃早点就好去，没人拦着你。”
昔小苑鄙视了一下沐梓丞就跑出门吃早餐去了。沐梓丞看昔小苑对他比了个中指，咦？什么意思？这手势是有什么含义吗？？？
沐梓丞有些疑惑的问系统说道：“阿苑比的那个手势是什么意思？？？”
系统如实回答的说道：“那个手势的意思就是说，鄙视你的意思。”
沐梓丞眉头一皱的说道：“鄙视吾？”
系统肯定的说道：“嗯，是的，就是鄙视你的意思。”
………………………时间分割线………………………
大街里的一个木头和稻草搭建的棚子下在免费派发粮食还有粥。来领米和喝粥的百姓有很多，个个手里拿着东西排着对等着派米和粥……
“排好队不要抢，一个一个来，着什么急呢~人人都有，注意秩序。”A地痞流氓头儿喊道。
“喂喂喂！你别抢呀，又不是不给你，你这人可真是的……”b地痞流氓撇了撇嘴巴，一脸不高兴。
“称好了，每人都按照一定的量给，不要着急，慢慢来~”c地痞流氓拿着秤子计算着多少重量。
“别害怕呀，又不会吃了你！”b地痞流氓看着那老百姓看着他的模样有些害怕，手还在颤抖着。
张文双手交叉在胸前，微微一笑的对百姓们说道：“都别害怕啊，有我在，他们都不敢造次，所以安心的领吧……”
而不远处有两个公子喝着茶悠闲自在的看着，昔小苑今天女扮男装，穿着一身淡绿色衣服，衣服秀着竹子的图案，头发两边编了个辫子围绕到脑后用一根淡绿色的带子绑在一起，额前一点刘海中分。
为什么今天昔小苑会穿成这样呢，因为今天要给百姓们分点粮食救济一下他们，大概要派发三天，而且这种抛头露面的事情她肯定要注意一下自己的形象，毕竟是个丞相嘛，而且如果给土匪盯上那还不惨吗？
所以她就女扮男装，因为百姓们都知道丞相是个女的了，如果她不打扮成男的话，到时引起什么状况她不就惨了吗，虽然暗中保护的暗卫很多，但是也难免没有意外呀……
如果她抛头露面什么的，让人知道她这个丞相长什么样，那到时还怎么计划剿土匪了，土匪知道她长什么样的话都不知道会不会把她给绑架当压寨夫人呢。
昔小苑喝口茶哼着小曲看着那群地痞流氓在帮忙着派发粮食，而俞月白有些嫌弃的对昔小苑说道：“哼什么曲呢，怪难听的，而且你今天穿的可真是……”
昔小苑鄙视的眼神对俞月白说道：“你懂什么呢，这叫时尚！算了，反正你是不会懂得了……”

她今天打扮的样子不知道多帅呢，张文都看傻样了都。
其实张文心里是这么想的，丞相好好的一个姑娘家突然穿成这样装成男子，可谓是让他大开眼界呀，以后不能用常人的思维眼光看待丞相了。
俞月白还没为早上发生的事情生气还没消下来，他有些没好气的对昔小苑说道：“不懂不懂不懂，不懂怎么啦，你有意见啊！”
昔小苑才不会跟他计较呢，有些哄孩子的语气说道：“好的吧，你不懂不怪你，哥哥我是不会跟你计较的哦~~”
俞月白气的脸都红了，这什么呀！明明他还救了她，女神现在还这么说他，生气！他现在很是憋屈委屈。
昔小苑看俞月白有些气鼓鼓的样子忍不住笑了一下，行吧，初吻那件事就不跟他计较了，事情都发生了也没法改变，所以她就认了吧。
昔小苑看了看周围，行吧~小丞丞没来，都不知道他干嘛去了，不来就算了，肯定不知去搞什么事情了。
不远处的一个小巷里躲着一个人，那人探出头来看着昔小苑这边的情况，随后转身离去。
召府里。
召簧躺在床上精神未定的看着床板发呆，昨晚真是太刺激了，那鬼可要把他吓死了，今天他不敢一个人睡了，今晚他要去跟夫人睡，不然今晚再来些什么东西他可就要吓的归西了。
召夫人看着召簧有些担忧的说道：“老爷呀，你昨晚到底发生了什么事情呀，你可要把妾身吓死了呀。”
召簧转过头来看着他的夫人，而后抓着他夫人的手说道：“夫人呐，今晚咱们可要小心了，晚上有什么动静发生什么都不要出去，闭着眼睛当什么都不知道，你可知道了吗？”
旁边一小妾有些疑惑的对召簧说道：“为什么呀老爷？到底发生了什么事情呀，不然老爷你今早也不会发生这种事情呀~~~”
召簧很是虚弱的对那小妾说道：“别问那么多了，听我的准没错。”而后召簧看着他的夫人着急的说道：“快去请道长过来，看看这屋里头是不是有什么邪祟。”
小主，这个章节后面还有哦，请点击下一页继续阅读，后面更精彩！
召夫人眉头一皱，紧张的说道：“邪祟？老爷呀，你就快说说怎么回事吧，你可要把妾身给急死了呀。”
召簧手颤抖着，说话都有些语无伦次了的说道：“就…就是…晚上不知有什么妖怪，头…头发很长看不见脸，而且穿着白色的衣服从门口掉了下来，而且没有脚，还在门口挂着。”
召簧手抖得厉害指着那门口，旁边那小妾听召簧这么一说，吓得自己都打了个冷颤，而召夫人看召簧这么害怕的模样自己都心惊了。
content_en:
Xi Xiaoyuan glared at Mu Zicheng fiercely and said with an indifferent expression: "Okay, forget it if I can't snatch you away. I'll go have breakfast. The adults don't remember the faults of the villains and won't care about you."
Mu Zicheng said with a look of disgust: "If you can't grab it, you can't grab it. There's so much nonsense. Just go and have breakfast if you want. No one will stop you."
Xi Xiaoyuan looked down upon Mu Zicheng and ran out to have breakfast. Mu Zicheng saw Xi Xiaoyuan giving him a middle finger, Huh? What's the meaning? Does this gesture mean something? ? ?
Mu Zicheng asked the system with some confusion: "What does A Yuanbi's gesture mean???"
The system answered truthfully: "That gesture means it despises you."
Mu Zicheng frowned and said, "You despise me?"
The system said firmly: "Well, yes, I mean to despise you."
………………………Time dividing line…………
Free food and porridge are distributed under a shed made of wood and straw on the street. There were many people coming to receive rice and porridge, and they all lined up with something in their hands, waiting to be given rice and porridge...
"Line up and don't rush. Come one by one. Why rush? Everyone has it. Pay attention to order." shouted the leader of local ruffian A.
"Hey, hey, hey! Don't grab it. It's not like I won't give it to you. You are really..." The local gangster curled his lips and looked unhappy.
"It's weighed, and everyone will be given a certain amount. Don't be anxious, take your time~" C, a ruffian, took a scale and calculated the weight.
"Don't be afraid, I won't eat you!" The local ruffian looked a little scared when he saw the common people looking at him, and his hands were still shaking.
Zhang Wen crossed his hands on his chest and said to the people with a slight smile: "Don't be afraid. With me here, they don't dare to make mistakes, so just accept it with peace of mind..."
Not far away, there were two young men drinking tea and watching leisurely. Today, Xi Xiaoyuan was disguised as a man, wearing a light green dress that showed a bamboo pattern. Her hair was braided on both sides and tied together with a light green ribbon around the back of her head. Her bangs were parted in the middle.
Why is Xi Xiaoyuan dressed like this today? Because today she has to distribute some food to the people to relieve them. It will take about three days to distribute it, and she must pay attention to her image when she is in public. After all, she is a prime minister, and wouldn't it be miserable if she was targeted by bandits?
So she disguised herself as a man, because the people all knew that the Prime Minister was a woman. If she didn't dress up as a man, wouldn't she be miserable if something happened? Although there were many secret guards to protect her, there would be no accidents...
If she makes a public appearance or something, and people know what she looks like as the prime minister, then how can she plan to suppress the bandits? If the bandits know what she looks like, they don't know whether they will kidnap her and use her as a village wife.
Xi Xiaoyuan drank tea and hummed a tune while watching the group of local ruffians helping distribute food. Yu Yuebai said to Xi Xiaoyuan with some disgust: "What song are you humming? It's so unpleasant. What's more, what you're wearing today is really..."
Xi Xiaoyuan looked at Yu Yuebai with contempt and said: "What do you know? This is called fashion! Forget it, you won't understand anyway..."
I don't know how handsome she looked dressed up today, even Zhang Wen looked stupid.
In fact, this is what Zhang Wen thought in his heart. The fact that a girl whom the Prime Minister loved suddenly dressed up like this and pretended to be a man was an eye-opener for him. In the future, he would no longer be able to look at the Prime Minister with ordinary people's thinking.
Yu Yuebai was still angry about what happened in the morning. He said to Xi Xiaoyuan angrily: "I don't understand, I don't understand, I don't understand what's going on. You have an opinion!"
Xi Xiaoyuan would not argue with him. She said in a coaxing tone: "Okay, I don't blame you if you don't understand, brother."I won’t argue with you~~”
Yu Yuebai's face turned red with anger, what is this! He obviously saved her, but the goddess is still talking about him like this, she's angry! He is very frustrated and aggrieved now.
Xi Xiaoyuan couldn't help but smile when she saw Yu Yuebai's angry look. Okay, let's not bother with him about the first kiss. Things had happened and there was nothing she could do to change them, so she just accepted it.
Xi Xiaoyuan looked around, okay~ Xiao Chengcheng didn't come, so he didn't know why he was there. Forget it if he didn't come, he must have done something else.
There was a person hiding in an alley not far away. The person stuck his head out and looked at the situation in Xi Xiaoyuan, then turned and left.
In the Zhaofu.
Zhao Huang lay on the bed and stared at the bed board in a daze. Last night was so exciting. The ghost would scare him to death. Today he dare not sleep alone. He has to sleep with his wife tonight, otherwise he will be scared to death if something comes tonight.
Mrs. Zhao looked at Zhao Huan and said worriedly: "Master, what happened to you last night? You must have scared me to death. "
Zhaohuang turned to look at his wife, then grabbed his wife's hand and said: "Madam, we have to be careful tonight. Don't go out if there is any movement or anything at night. Close your eyes and pretend you don't know anything. Do you understand? "
The concubine next to him said to Zhaohuang with some confusion: "Why, sir? What happened? Otherwise, sir, this kind of thing wouldn’t have happened to you this morning~~~”
Zhao Huang said to the concubine very weakly: "Don't ask so many questions, just listen to what I said. Then Zhaohuang looked at his wife and said anxiously: "Go and ask the Taoist priest to come over and see if there is anything evil in this room." "
My dear, there is more to come after this chapter. Please click on the next page to continue reading. There will be more exciting chapters later!
Madam Zhao frowned and said nervously: "Evil spirit? Master, please tell me what's going on. You're going to scare me to death. "
Zhaohuan's hands were trembling, and he spoke incoherently: "It's just... there is some kind of monster at night, with long... hair that makes it hard to see his face, and he was wearing white clothes and fell out of the door. He has no feet and is still hanging at the door. "
Zhao Huan's hand was shaking so much that he pointed at the door. The concubine next to him was so frightened that he shivered when he heard what Zhao Huan said. Mrs. Zhao was even frightened when she saw how scared Zhao Huan looked.
